description: This file defines a mock class 'MockServerProcess' used for testing server process behaviors, including methods for reading stdout, writing, starting, stopping, and checking crash status.

classes.name: MockServerProcess
classes.description: A mock class simulating server process behavior for testing purposes, with methods to read output, write input, control process state, and check crash status.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the mock server process with optional parameters for command, environment, logging, and crash simulation.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends bytes to the internal writes list, simulating writing to the process.

methods.name: has_crashed
methods.description: Returns whether the process has crashed.

methods.name: read_stdout_line
methods.description: Returns the next line of stdout output, appending a newline.

methods.name: read_stdout
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from stdout, handling partial lines.

methods.name: pop_all_buffered_stderr
methods.description: Returns an empty string, simulating no stderr output.

methods.name: read_either_stdout_or_stderr_line
methods.description: Returns a stdout line and None for stderr, simulating interleaved output.
